<function name="IsPointInBounds" parent="Entity" type="classfunc">
	<description>
Returns whether a given point is within the entity's Orientated Bounding Box.

This relies on the entity having a collision mesh (not a physics object) and will be affected by `SOLID_NONE`.
	</description>
	<added>2022.08.02</added>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<args>
		<arg name="point" type="Vector">The point to test, in world space coordinates.</arg>
	</args>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="boolean">Whether the point is within the entity's bounds.</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
